item.title: F.C.C. Chair Threatens to Revoke Broadcasters’ Licenses Over War Coverage
item.summary: The comment from Brendan Carr came on the heels of a social media message from President Trump criticizing the news media’s coverage of the war with Iran.

item.title: Here’s What Happened in the U.S.-Israel War With Iran on Saturday
item.summary: The U.S. Embassy in Baghdad was attacked overnight. Israeli strikes continued to hit the capitals of Iran and Lebanon, as Iran refused to relinquish control over a vital oil route.

item.title: Tehran Seems Largely Empty, as Many Flee and Others Weary of the Fighting
item.summary: Residents say a heavy, lifeless atmosphere hangs over the streets of Iran’s capital, which has endured relentless attacks throughout the war.

item.title: How a Marine Unit in the Middle East Could Open New Phase of Iran War
item.summary: The unit’s arrival in the coming days will give the Pentagon the ability to quickly launch raids.

item.title: Sandstorm Batters Gaza, Slamming Makeshift Shelters
item.summary: Millions of Gazans have remained without proper housing since the war, according to the United Nations.

item.title: Dozens of Medical Workers Killed as Israel Hits Lebanon
item.summary: Lebanese health officials say that 31 health workers have been killed by Israeli strikes. Israel claimed, without evidence, that Hezbollah has been using ambulances and medical facilities.

item.title: Lebanon’s Displaced Flee Israeli Strikes One Year Into War
item.summary: Israeli calls for the evacuation of huge swaths of southern Lebanon have led 830,000 people, about 14 percent of Lebanon’s population, to flee.

item.title: Netanyahu Has the War He Always Wanted, but on Trump’s Terms
item.summary: Israel’s prime minister wanted regime change in Iran. But President Trump seems prepared to settle for something less.

item.title: Tim Kaine Is Forcing the Iran War Debate From the Minority
item.summary: Senator Tim Kaine, Democrat of Virginia, has found a way to repeatedly occupy floor time and force all senators to take votes challenging President Trump’s use of military force.

item.title: Why Little Was Done to Head Off Oil’s Strait of Hormuz Problem
item.summary: Geography and regional rivalries have prevented Gulf countries from finding a true alternative to the strait, which the war with Iran has effectively shut down.
